pages.title: Steal Animal Eggs Online
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Raid guarded nests in Steal Animal Eggs Online. Carry stolen eggs back to your base, hatch new animals, and train to improve your running speed before exploring more areas. Play online alone or share the keyboard with a second player while escaping the nests' protectors.

pages.title: Blankets
pages.creator: Omni Play
pages.description: Clear colored squares to help a chilly cat in Blankets. Choose a lane for each falling square and bring two matching colors together to remove them. Plan around the growing stacks so the board keeps offering space for another square.

pages.title: Blue VS Red
pages.creator: KekeFWT
pages.description: Send blue objects left and red objects right in Blue VS Red. Drag them into the matching zones or use the arrow keys during a thirty-second round. Chain correct decisions for combo bonuses, then spend earned coins on power-ups for later attempts.

pages.title: Skillful Finger
pages.creator: GamesMrkt
pages.description: Follow a glowing path in Skillful Finger. Keep contact with the screen while sliding along the line, avoiding barriers and the outer edges as the speed increases. Customize the moving ball and its trail before tackling another generated route.

pages.title: Stickman Weapon Master
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Battle through a hostile land in Stickman Weapon Master. Equip different weapons and learn how their attacks behave as the lone fighter faces opposing forces. Use the available combat styles to work through encounters on the journey toward the land's ruler.

pages.title: Scary Teacher 3D Returns
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Cause trouble inside a teacher's mansion in Scary Teacher 3D Returns. Explore the house and carry out mischief while paying attention to nearby sounds and movement. Avoid being caught by the teacher as you work through the pranks around her home.

pages.title: CloneUp - Stack Yourself
pages.creator: Low Pixel Byte
pages.description: Use copies of your character to cross platforming levels in CloneUp - Stack Yourself. Create clones, stack them, and climb onto them to reach otherwise inaccessible areas. Position the copies to bypass spikes and build a path toward the exit door.

pages.title: 3D Super Rolling Ball Race
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Control a rolling ball across raised courses in 3D Super Rolling Ball Race. Guide it over the platforms, adjusting its route before bends and gaps. Stay on the track and keep the ball from falling as the race continues through the three-dimensional layout.

pages.title: Super Slime
pages.creator: Kool Games
pages.description: Guide a stretchy hero through a hundred stages in Super Slime. Bounce across platforms, dodge obstacles, and deal with enemies on the route. Use keyboard movement or the virtual joystick to control the slime as the layouts demand more precise jumps.

pages.title: Lovie Chics Spring Break Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Create warm-weather outfits in Lovie Chics Spring Break Fashion. Choose from bright dresses, swimwear, and accessories to style the characters for their holiday plans. Compare the wardrobe options and finish each look with the pieces that suit your spring-break theme.

pages.title: Destruction of Stickman Zombie
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Clear every room of undead enemies in Destruction of Stickman Zombie. Use weapons to defeat the stick figures and collect coins for stronger equipment. Keep track of ammunition as the stages continue, buying additional guns to support later fights against the zombie groups.

pages.title: Muscle Up Master
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Build stronger fighters in Muscle Up Master. Merge matching characters to improve their level, then enter tournaments when the opportunity becomes available. During fights, click rapidly to challenge the opponent and use the results to continue developing your group of athletes.

pages.title: Combinations Daily
pages.creator: Denda Games
pages.description: Connect matching tiles in Combinations Daily. Find useful combinations of the same elements and work through the board's arrangement to complete the puzzle. Return for a new daily challenge and maintain the monthly streak by continuing to finish the changing layouts.

pages.title: Black Hole vs Monster
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Collect a fighting force with a moving black hole in Black Hole vs Monster. Sweep up an army, then send it against the boss waiting at the end. Upgrade the hole so it can prepare a stronger force for larger monsters.

pages.title: Extreme Bus Driver Simulator
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Carry city passengers in Extreme Bus Driver Simulator. Follow the route to collect people at stops and deliver them to their next destinations. Steer the bus with the driving keys and use the available nitro when the road calls for extra speed.

pages.title: Surfer Cat
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Ride ocean waves as a feline surfer in Surfer Cat. Collect seashells while steering clear of rocks along the water route. The waves and obstacle arrangements become more demanding as you advance, requiring earlier decisions about where the cat should travel next.

pages.title: Only Up 3D Parkour Go Ascend
pages.creator: Craft Game World RA
pages.description: Climb a trail of suspended objects in Only Up 3D Parkour Go Ascend. Jump onto floating cars, houses, boxes, and pipes to gain height above the world. Move the camera to judge the next landing and keep building a route farther into the sky.

pages.title: Melonman
pages.creator: Melon Gaming
pages.description: Keep the runner moving in Melonman. Tap to jump over obstacles along the scrolling route, timing the leap so the character can continue into the next section. Each attempt centers on covering more ground without being stopped by the hazards ahead.

pages.title: Zombie Area
pages.creator: ravel
pages.description: Clear an invaded house in Zombie Area. Shoot the zombies blocking each section and keep moving toward the next area's doors. Surviving the encounters and eliminating the threats opens a way farther through the building toward the exit.

pages.title: Castel Wars Modern
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fight across modern and futuristic arenas in Castel Wars Modern. Choose among modes including zombie battles and two-player combat, using the weapons supplied by the setting. Moon bases and city environments provide different places for the series' platform-based confrontations.

pages.title: Puzzle Love
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Bring a couple together in Puzzle Love. Slide blocks into empty spaces to open a route through each arrangement, keeping the characters clear of hostile figures. Think through the next shift before moving too close to an enemy or blocking the path again.

pages.title: Mermaid My Valentine Crush
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Help two mermaids reunite in Mermaid My Valentine Crush. Tap to jump through the platform puzzles, choosing a safe moment to pass traps and other obstacles. Work through thirty stages to reach the end of the couple's Valentine's adventure.

pages.title: Stick Soccer 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Play turn-based football in Stick Soccer 3D. Select a player, aim with the mouse, and release to strike the ball toward the opposing goal. Choose teams, tactics, and stadiums for solo or two-player matches, with a speed mode offering another way to compete.

pages.title: Parkour GO
pages.creator: Rassl.me
pages.description: Cross obstacle courses on foot in Parkour GO. Sprint, jump, slide, and climb through the structures to reach the finish. Switch between first-person and third-person views, or practice movement in the free-roaming areas before attempting another course.

pages.title: First Day Of School
pages.creator: FreezeNova.Games
pages.description: Help a class get ready for lessons in First Day Of School. Prepare the characters, assist with classroom puzzles, and take part in the school's activities. Tap the scene's objects to move between the makeover preparations and the teacher's tasks.

pages.title: Zombie Mission 10: More Mayhem
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Return to an overrun prison in Zombie Mission 10: More Mayhem. Guide the heroes through traps, zombies, and bosses, using weapons and grenades to clear the route. Two players have separate movement and attack controls for working through the mission together.

pages.title: Noob vs pro 2 Jailbreak
pages.creator: Noob vs Pro team
pages.description: Work toward a prison escape in Noob vs pro 2 Jailbreak. Guide the characters through physics-based stages and earn money for improvements to their escape equipment. Upgrade the available transport, including a boat, as the struggle against Hacker continues beyond the cells.

pages.title: Stunt Crazy
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Destroy film sets as a stunt driver in Stunt Crazy. Launch over obstacles, fire missiles, and use turbo or a crash bomb while managing fuel. Collect colored stunt reels to meet the objectives, with awards and stunt shows marking progress through twenty-four sets.

pages.title: Sand Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Sort colored sand between glasses in Sand Sort Puzzle. Pour matching layers together until a glass holds a single color, causing a flower to appear above it. Plan around the free space in the remaining glasses and restart the arrangement if the sequence becomes blocked.

pages.title: Snake Rush
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Steer a red snake through an ongoing obstacle run in Snake Rush. Drag to change its position and find a route through the barriers ahead. Keep the snake moving safely for longer attempts as you try to improve the score.

pages.title: Halloween Link
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Remove pairs of spooky tiles in Halloween Link. Select identical pictures that can be joined by a clear line with no more than two bends. Work through the available connections until every tile has been cleared from the board.

pages.title: Flat Jewels Match 3
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description: Swap gems into rows or columns of at least three in Flat Jewels Match 3. Complete tasks across a hundred and fifty levels or choose Time Attack to pursue a high score. The two modes use the same matching board with different goals for each attempt.

pages.title: Jump Me
pages.creator: katanigames
pages.description: Plan a knight's route through checkerboard puzzles in Jump Me. Use chess-style jumps to reach the required tiles, choosing moves that keep the remaining squares accessible. Each layout asks you to think ahead about where the horse can land next.

pages.title: Pull Mermaid Out
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Help a mermaid leave a ruined ancient city in Pull Mermaid Out. Remove pins from the drainage passages in an order that opens a safe route home. Check what each pin is holding back before releasing it into the mermaid's path.

pages.title: Fruits and Vegetables
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Practice counting with pictures of produce in Fruits and Vegetables. Look at the displayed group and select the quantity that matches it. Continue through new arrangements of fruit and vegetables, checking each group before choosing an answer.

pages.title: Monster Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear timed bubble boards in Monster Bubble Shooter. Aim at matching monster pieces and form groups that can be removed from the arrangement. Finish each level before its time limit expires, with quicker completions producing a better score.

pages.title: Draw Parking
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Sketch a safe route to a parking space in Draw Parking. Drag a line from the car to its designated destination, steering the planned path around obstacles. Complete more parking layouts to progress through the stages and unlock additional vehicles.

pages.title: Summer Brick Out
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Break a field of bricks in Summer Brick Out. Move the paddle to keep the ball in play, collecting bonuses dropped by destroyed blocks. Catch falling clocks to extend the remaining time while working toward removing the whole arrangement.

pages.title: Bubble Split
pages.creator: Viango Games
pages.description: Reunite separated bubbles in Bubble Split. Click the positions that bring the pieces back together into one form. Consider the placement before committing, since choosing the wrong spot ends the attempt.

pages.title: Easter Day 2020 Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore seasonal pictures in Easter Day 2020 Slide. Choose one of three Easter images and a difficulty mode, then slide the scrambled sections into their proper arrangement. Use the picture details to determine which neighboring section needs to move next.

pages.title: Fun Monster Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Reassemble vehicle pictures in Fun Monster Trucks Jigsaw. Choose a difficulty and drag the scattered pieces into their matching positions. Completing puzzles earns in-game money for buying additional pictures, with harder layouts offering a larger reward for finishing the truck image.

pages.title: Big Game Hunting
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Practice with a sniper rifle in Big Game Hunting. Track moving mechanical targets and release the shot when the sights are aligned. Use each target's movement to judge the timing and build a better score during the simulated shooting session.

pages.title: Snake and Ladders Game
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Race along a board in Snake and Ladders Game. Roll the die and advance by its result, taking ladders upward while snakes send a piece back down. Play alone or with a friend and try to reach the final square before the opponent does.

pages.title: Ice Princess Doll House
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Design a winter castle in Ice Princess Doll House. Choose furnishings and decorations for Princess Frosie's rooms, arranging the home to suit its icy theme. Work through the interior choices to prepare the dollhouse before the approaching storm reaches the princess.

pages.title: Happy Bike Riding Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Rebuild cycling scenes in Happy Bike Riding Jigsaw. Select one of twelve pictures and choose a layout with twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces. Connect the scattered sections by their edges and image details until the bike-riding picture is complete.

pages.title: FZ Perfect Turn
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Roll a colored sponge over the floor in FZ Perfect Turn. Use the movement keys to change its position and paint the uncovered tiles. Work out the turns needed to cover the layout, checking how the sponge's shape fits the space ahead.

pages.title: City Furious Car Driving Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive sports cars around an urban setting in City Furious Car Driving Simulator. Accelerate along the streets, turn through the road network, and use the handbrake to control sharper changes of direction. Explore the city while managing the car's speed through each stretch of road.

pages.title: Funny Dentist Surgery
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Treat Leah's damaged teeth in Funny Dentist Surgery. Select the dental tools and work through the problems revealed during her visit. After completing the treatment steps, decorate the repaired teeth with the game's stickers to finish her virtual appointment.

pages.title: Flappy Snowball Xmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Keep a snowball airborne in Flappy Snowball Xmas. Click or tap to bounce it upward and guide it through hoops, aiming for precise dunks that award extra points. Build a higher score to unlock more snowman characters for later attempts.

pages.title: Happy Ski Dressup
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Choose a winter-sports outfit in Happy Ski Dressup. Browse clothing and accessories to prepare the character for a trip to the ski field. Combine the available pieces into a finished cold-weather look before she joins the holiday outing.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Tea Party
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel organize a gathering in Baby Hazel Tea Party. Assist with invitations, preparations, and getting ready while her parents help around the house. Respond to the characters' requests so the remaining tasks are finished before the friends arrive for tea.

pages.title: Merge Tower Animals
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Build stronger animal defenders in Merge Tower Animals. Combine matching creatures to improve their power, then use them against approaching enemies. Collect coins to buy additional animals and keep merging as you progress toward tougher waves and higher levels.

pages.title: Circular Spiral Jump
pages.creator: Thumb Game Studio
pages.description: Run around a winding elevated course in Circular Spiral Jump. Click or tap to jump when an obstacle or gap approaches, keeping the character on the spiral platform. Judge the landing point carefully so a successful leap leads into the next section of the route.

pages.title: Arrow Combo
pages.creator: Plug in Digital
pages.description: Shoot arrows at targets in Arrow Combo. Aim for accurate hits to extend a combo and increase the score, adjusting for each target's position. Keep the sequence going to improve the result as another target presents a fresh shot.

pages.title: Infinite Golf Star
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Play through an ongoing sequence of courses in Infinite Golf Star. Aim each stroke to send the ball toward the hole, working around the obstacles in the layout. Complete one hole to face another arrangement and continue the golf challenge.

pages.title: BTS Shark Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Paint a selection of shark illustrations in BTS Shark Coloring Book. Choose colors and apply them to the drawings, changing the appearance of the sharks and their surrounding details. Complete one picture in your preferred style before beginning another coloring design.

pages.title: Color Race
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Steer a ball into matching colors in Color Race. Move left or right to meet another ball of the same color, adjusting when your own ball changes. Keep watching both the current color and the arrangement ahead to select the next safe match.

pages.title: Indian Cargo Truck Driver
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive heavy vehicles through a sequence of assignments in Indian Cargo Truck Driver. Choose from the available trucks and use the driving keys to handle each course. Switch the camera view when another angle helps you judge the truck's position along the route.

pages.title: Hill Billy Hank
pages.creator: IDLA Games
pages.description: Defend against zombies in Hill Billy Hank. Click or touch the screen to shoot, selecting the undead threats that need to be stopped. Keep firing at approaching enemies as the defense continues and more zombies enter the scene.

pages.title: Sports Car Dock Parking
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Complete parking challenges beside the water in Sports Car Dock Parking. Drive the sports car into its designated position without striking the barriers. Change the camera to judge tight spaces and customize the vehicle before returning to the next parking stage.

pages.title: Oddbods Monster Truck
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guide an Oddbods monster truck to the flag in Oddbods Monster Truck. Accelerate, brake, and tilt the vehicle to handle hills and uneven sections of the route. Choose an Oddbods driver and pursue faster finishes to earn more stars across the levels.

pages.title: Escape Point 4
pages.creator: GamesPoint
pages.description: Find a way out of a locked hospital in Escape Point 4. Search the rooms for useful objects and clues, then apply them to the puzzles blocking the tourist's escape. Link the discoveries together to open the route out of the building.

pages.title: 2 Cars Online
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Control two vehicles at once in 2 Cars Online. Switch each car's lane to collect every flag while avoiding traffic cones along the route. Missing a flag or hitting a cone ends the run, so watch both sides instead of concentrating on just one car.

pages.title: Corporate Overlord
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Develop a fictional business empire in Corporate Overlord. Construct facilities such as chemical laboratories and quantum-computing labs, then research technologies to expand the corporation's capabilities. Reinvest the growing business's income in more structures and projects as you pursue its world-domination objective.

pages.title: Hardest Parking
pages.creator: yupiy
pages.description: Maneuver a car into restricted spaces in Hardest Parking. Approach the designated spot carefully and adjust the steering to place the vehicle correctly. Work through the available parking layouts, judging the room around the car before committing to another turn.

pages.title: EG Tappy Plane
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Keep a plane airborne through an endless route in EG Tappy Plane. Tap to control its height while avoiding mountain peaks and hostile aircraft. Survive farther into the flight to build the score, with the hazards becoming more demanding as the run continues.

pages.title: Dumb Ways Jr Zanys Hospital
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Explore a playful medical center in Dumb Ways Jr Zanys Hospital. Visit the waiting room, assist Doctor Zany with checkups, and investigate the arriving ambulance. Interact with the characters and objects across the three areas to discover the hospital's activities and guest appearances.

pages.title: Unblock Me Deluxe
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Free a blocked wooden piece in Unblock Me Deluxe. Slide the surrounding blocks along their available directions until a path opens to the exit. Plan the order of moves so making room for one piece does not trap the next block you need to shift.

pages.title: Dress Design for Princess
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help Annie prepare entries for a bridal-fashion contest in Dress Design for Princess. Create three different wedding dresses, choosing the design details for each one. Complete the collection so the designer can present her finished dresses to the judges.

pages.title: Camping Adventure: Family Road Trip
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Join a family outing in Camping Adventure: Family Road Trip. Work through the events that arise during the journey, helping with the car, tent, and campfire. Select the objects needed to solve each problem and keep the camping weekend moving forward.

pages.title: Speed Ball
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Guide a ball down an obstacle-filled route in Speed Ball. Move around the barriers while keeping pace with the increasing speed. Survive farther through the ongoing stages by reading the open spaces ahead and reacting before the next obstacle reaches the ball.

pages.title: Happy Thanksgiving Cake Master
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Decorate a seasonal dessert in Happy Thanksgiving Cake Master. Choose the cake's appearance and arrange the available toppings and finishing details. Combine the decorations into a Thanksgiving design, changing the selected pieces until the holiday cake has the look you want.

pages.title: Football Legends Head Soccer
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Compete in oversized-headed football matches in Football Legends Head Soccer. Control a player, strike the ball toward the opposing goal, and defend your own end of the field. Build a lead by timing attacks around the opponent's position during the match.

pages.title: Rolly Vortex
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Roll a ball through a winding tunnel in Rolly Vortex. Steer around the barriers without crashing, keeping the run going to increase the score. Collect dots along the route to unlock more balls and use them in later attempts through the vortex.

pages.title: Mermaid Princess Heal and Spa
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help an injured mermaid recover in Mermaid Princess Heal and Spa. Remove the anchor, repair her tail with the magic wand, and clean away the dirt. Follow the treatment with hair care and face masks to complete her visit to the spa.

pages.title: Fancy Cars Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find five concealed shapes in each level of Fancy Cars Hidden Stars. Examine the car picture closely and select the stars hidden among its details. Mark all five to unlock the next scene and begin another search around a different vehicle.

pages.title: Ellie Beach Proposal
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Prepare a romantic beach dinner in Ellie Beach Proposal. Decorate the setting with candles and flowers, then guide the couple through music, strawberries, and shared kisses. Complete the dinner's interactions as the evening leads toward the boyfriend's proposal.

pages.title: Breaking Lines
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Guide a glowing orb through shadowy obstacles in Breaking Lines. Bounce past the dark shapes and cross the goal line to finish each stage. A collision makes the orb burst, so judge the next movement before sending it through a narrow opening.

pages.title: Draculaura Dentist
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Treat a character's dental problems in Draculaura Dentist. Examine the teeth, choose the appropriate tools, and work through the care steps needed to repair them. Continue the virtual appointment until the problems in the mouth have been addressed.

pages.title: Ninja Arena
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Clear numbered shurikens from the board in Ninja Arena. Use the pieces outside the arena to attack those already inside, planning each turn around the remaining arrangement. Keep opening space so the board does not fill, and extend the game to increase the score.

pages.title: Zombie Killing Spree
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight for survival in Zombie Killing Spree. Move through a randomly generated area, eliminate the undead, and choose upgrades to strengthen the character during the run. Each attempt creates a different arrangement of threats as you work to stay alive longer.

pages.title: Four Roads
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Guide a moving piece through narrow courses in Four Roads. Tap to change direction at the right moment, lining up the next stretch before reaching a corner. Stay clear of the course boundaries and work toward completing each road layout.

pages.title: FlakBoy Escape
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Help FlakBoy cross a dangerous industrial setting in FlakBoy Escape. Guide him through the factory's hazards, choosing a safe moment to move into the next space. Keep advancing without meeting the traps that can end his escape attempt.

pages.title: Popstar Trivia
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Identify music celebrities against the clock in Popstar Trivia. Look at the displayed performer and select a name from the multiple-choice options before the timer expires. Correct identifications add to the result as new faces appear during the quiz.

pages.title: Princesses Shopping Spree
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help two princesses choose new outfits in Princesses Shopping Spree. Visit their selected stores and compare dresses, shoes, and handbags for each character. Put together both looks from the available items to complete the pair's trip around the mall.
